name: German office intent blind holdout v4
description: 270 synthetic German questions, 30 per intent, written on 11.11.2026 by four independent agents that knew only the intent definitions and no code, prompt, training data, holdout or error (Bavarian, Austrian and Franconian with dictation; Swabian, Alemannic and Swiss German, terse; Cologne/Rhineland, Hessian, Palatine and Saarland, long sentences with reasons; Berlin, Saxon, Low German and German as a second language with typos). Sentences at 0.8 or more similarity to any training, holdout, probe, template or sealed sentence and near duplicates were removed; a fifth agent assigned every sentence blind, and only sentences with the same intent and no ambiguity were kept. No real persons, companies or customer data.
